steps.instruction: Read the request and declared evidence. Freeze one written flow, admissions at the pinned commit, attested endpoint and served head, account reference, seed namespace, environment authority, exclusive lease and new append-only run identity. Create none of the prerequisites here.

calls.purpose: Read exact flow and prerequisite evidence.
Verify served-head ancestry for the pinned commit.

produces: Frozen UAT snapshot and prerequisite classification.

steps.instruction: Probe the exact attested endpoint and open it in a fresh browser context. Resolve the account credential by name only at sign-in. Confirm admission, lease and seed namespace are current before case execution.

calls.purpose: Reach the guarded or public entry in an isolated browser context.

steps.instruction: Run the frozen written walk exactly. Capture each case's browser actions, assertions, data observations and screenshot, masking credential fields before any pixels are retained. Do not invent steps or reuse prior-run captures.

calls.purpose: Execute the exact browser walk and collect evidence.
Persist the frozen snapshot and actual case captures.

steps.instruction: Inspect actual case evidence, judge behavior, data and experience lanes independently, verify all writes stayed inside the namespace, then remove exactly that namespace. Record concrete case defects and reassess affected lanes after a targeted rerun under a new attempt.

writes.when: when the run can be recorded

calls.purpose: Verify and remove only the bound UAT namespace.
Persist lane verdicts and append-only run evidence.

produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with current run artifacts, observations and review results. Present complete case outcomes and significant captures; never use a prior pass image for the current attempt.

calls.purpose: Present current case evidence and lane verdicts.
